dogecoin.text: Does anyone know about good resources for crypto recovery? I have a lot of Dogecoin from years ago that I have sitting on a hard drive. Pretty sure I have to resync the block chain and crack my password (which I have very strong guesses for). @JuanJSebGarcia

I found my #dogecoin wallet backup from 2015! Let's hope it still works! 
If anyone wants to get started with #cryptocurrency, here is my Coinbase referal link: https://t.co/eK0NPQ3dWq
If you sign up with my link and buy $100 worth of coins, we both get $10 in Bitcoin.

Spent 1hr learning how #hashcat works to decrypt a crypto wallet, loaded a custom char set & dictionary, & hoped it wouldn't take over a month to crack. 

10 seconds later: It was one of the dictionary phrases...

At least I know how hashcat works now! And I have my Dogecoin!
